requirements.statement: A competent worker must be able to restart the project without prior chat history.
Material knowledge and consequential changes must be persistently traceable in Git/GitHub.
New aspects must be assessed against existing objective, state, requirements and decisions before canonical integration.
The system must distinguish AI capability from authority and prevent silent promotion of judgement-heavy candidates.
The system must detect required domain, method, project, technical and interface competencies for material work.
Relevant competencies must research current state of the art, best practice and project fit when material uncertainty warrants it.
Requirements, criteria, decisions, implementation and verification must be linkable end-to-end.
Clerical project-operation work should be automated so human attention is reserved for meaning, authority and acceptance.
The template must support outcomes ranging from knowledge artifacts to pure software, backend, data systems or AI-enabled products.
Data, backend, ML/AI, infrastructure and DevOps choices must be derived from observed needs rather than prescribed by the template.
Deterministic checks, judgement-based reviews and human acceptance must remain distinguishable.
The repository must provide a minimal executable operational core for inspect, context, integrate, validate, trace, derive and audit capabilities.
